description: Set the two-way sync of an already-connected Attio integration, using the stored access token, so changing mappings does not require connect_integration or the Attio access token again. Sequenzy → Attio: listMap (Sequenzy list id → Attio list) and tagMap (Sequenzy tag → Attio list) upsert the person and add them to the Attio list when they join the list or get the tag. Attio → Sequenzy: inboundListMap (Attio list → Sequenzy list id) and inboundTagMap (Attio list → Sequenzy tag) create or update the subscriber and add them to the list or tag when someone is added to the Attio list, which triggers list and tag automations. Saving an inbound map makes Sequenzy register the Attio webhook itself; that needs the webhook:read-write scope on the token, and the call fails with instructions when it is missing. Each map is a full replacement: pass the complete desired map, `{}` to clear it, or omit it to leave it unchanged. syncRemovals (default false) mirrors removals in every mapped direction; off keeps sync add-only. Optionally set syncCompanyFromDomain. Provide at least one field. Idempotent: asking for the current state succeeds with changed: false. Only changes after saving sync; existing members are not backfilled. Check get_attio_mapping first for Sequenzy list ids and live Attio list ids/slugs, and list_tags for tag names. Attio only. Requires an API key with the `integrations:manage` scope, which agent-safe keys deliberately do not carry; without it, the same settings are available in the dashboard at Settings -> Integrations -> Attio -> Sync settings.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

inboundListMap.description: Attio → Sequenzy. Complete map of Attio people-list UUID or api slug to Sequenzy list id. Stored with Attio list UUIDs. Replaces the saved map; `{}` clears it; omit to leave it unchanged. Needs the webhook:read-write scope on the Attio token.

inboundTagMap.description: Attio → Sequenzy. Complete map of Attio people-list UUID or api slug to Sequenzy tag name. Replaces the saved map; `{}` clears it; omit to leave it unchanged. Needs the webhook:read-write scope on the Attio token.

integrationId.description: Attio integration ID from list_integrations or get_integration.

listMap.description: Sequenzy → Attio. Complete map of Sequenzy list id to Attio people-list UUID or api slug. Replaces the saved map. Pass `{}` to clear every mapping. Omit to leave mappings unchanged.

syncCompanyFromDomain.description: When true, upsert a company from the person's non-free-mail email domain. Omit to leave the current setting unchanged.

syncRemovals.description: When true, leaving a mapped Sequenzy list or losing a mapped tag removes the Attio list entry, and removal from a mapped Attio list removes the Sequenzy list membership or tag. Omit to leave the current setting unchanged.

tagMap.description: Sequenzy → Attio. Complete map of Sequenzy tag name to Attio people-list UUID or api slug. Tag names are normalized like stored tags (lowercase, spaces become dashes). Replaces the saved map; `{}` clears it; omit to leave it unchanged.

name: update_attio_settings

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_attio_settings` MCP tool.

attioLists.description: Attio people-lists the stored token can write, read live from Attio (id, apiSlug, name).

items.description: An Attio people-list: id, apiSlug, and name.

changed.description: False when the integration was already in the requested state.

changedFields.description: Which settings actually moved: listMap, tagMap, inboundListMap, inboundTagMap, syncRemovals, and/or syncCompanyFromDomain, plus inboundWebhook when the save set up, repaired or removed the Attio webhook.

inbound.description: Inbound sync health: enabled, status (`off`, `active`, or `error`), error (what to fix when status is `error`), and webhookUrl.

inboundListMap.description: Saved Attio list UUID → Sequenzy list id (Attio → Sequenzy).

inboundMappingCount.description: Saved Attio → Sequenzy mappings whose Attio source and Sequenzy target both still exist.

inboundTagMap.description: Saved Attio list UUID → Sequenzy tag (Attio → Sequenzy).

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

listMap.description: Saved Sequenzy list id → Attio list UUID or api slug after the update.

mappedListCount.description: Number of saved mappings whose Sequenzy source and Attio target lists both still exist after the update. Stale preserved entries are not counted.

mappedTagCount.description: Saved tag mappings whose Attio target list still exists.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequenzyLists.description: This company's Sequenzy lists (id and name).

items.description: A Sequenzy list: id and name.

syncCompanyFromDomain.description: Whether company matching from work-email domains is on after the update.

syncRemovals.description: Whether removals are mirrored in every mapped direction. False means add-only.

tagMap.description: Saved Sequenzy tag → Attio list UUID or api slug (Sequenzy → Attio).

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
